value.title: I've Always Liked You: Confess Your Love Committee
value.synopsis: Natsuki Enomoto, a third-year student at Sakuragaoka High School, has feelings of unrequited love for her childhood friend, Yuu Setoguchi. Unable to be true to her own feelings, Natsuki tells Yuu that she is merely using him as a stand-in to practice confessing her love to. As Natsuki continues to pretend not having any feelings for Yuu, her classmate Koyuki Ayase asks her out on a date. Will Natsuki ever be able to stop "practicing" and actually confess her love to Yuu?

value.title: The Moment You Fall in Love: Confess Your Love Committee
value.synopsis: Based on Vocaloid songs from "Kokuhaku Jikko Iinkai ~Renai Series~" by HoneyWorks, the movie is the second film based on the songs, following Tetsuya Yanagisawa's previous anime, "Zutto Mae Kara Suki Deshita".

value.title: I've Always Liked You: A Friday's Good Morning
value.synopsis: A picture drama special bundled with the BD/DVD release of the main film. It focuses on the relationship between Sena and Midori.
